versions.content: Data Communication Graph with Fan-In and Inter- ECU Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00305 Inter-ECU communication shall not be configured on a Data Communication Graphs which is handled by a Cross Software Cluster Communication Plug-In only or by a Local Software Cluster Communication Plug-In and a Cross Software Cluster Communication Plug-In where a Variable- DataPrototype instance in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype for which an VariableAccess of a RunnableEntity in the role dataReceivePointByArgu- ment or dataReceivePointByValue or dataReadAccess exists AND • for the dataElement "last-is-best" semantics (swImplPolicy = standard) applies.
